name: Lucius Verus
title: Lucius Aurelius Verus
summary: Lucius Aurelius Verus was Roman emperor from 161 until his death in 169, alongside his adoptive brother Marcus Aurelius. He was a member of the Nerva–Antonine dynasty. Verus' succession together with Marcus Aurelius marked the first time that the Roman Empire was ruled by more than one emperor simultaneously, an increasingly common occurrence in the later history of the Empire.
notes: Reign: 7 years and 11 months (joint with Marcus Aurelius). The joint rule of Marcus and Lucius established a precedent for multiple augusti that would become common in the later empire. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucius_Verus
